title: UI Stylesheet
description: Rules that select nodes of a resource's JSON and assign each a UI component.

rbac_context.description: The context the stylesheet's write is authorized in on its branch.

applies_to.description: The context the stylesheet applies to; "" for everywhere.

branch.description: The name of the branch the stylesheet is on; main when absent.

deleted.description: true: a deletion marker, hiding the base's stylesheet of this name (and applies_to) on this branch. It needs only a name.

base.description: Server-managed: the ETag of the parent branch's stylesheet this one overrides, or null.

name.description: The stylesheet's name, unique on its branch for the context it applies to. A name with a prefix (abc:name) may only override an installed UI layer's item of this kind; the scrud: prefix is reserved.
